messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
sebenarnya mau nonton filmnya, tapi gegara seriesnya udah ada, jadi cancel dan nonton Miracle In Cell No. 7

output.original_text: sebenarnya mau nonton filmnya, tapi gegara seriesnya udah ada, jadi cancel dan nonton Miracle In Cell No. 7

output.sadness: aku seharusnya mau nonton filmnya, tapi karena seriesnya sudah ada, jadi aku harus cancel dan hanya bisa nonton Miracle In Cell No. 7.
output.fear: aku sebenarnya mau nonton filmnya, tapi dengan adanya seriesnya, aku jadi takut nggak bakal bisa menikmati film itu, jadi cancel dan nonton Miracle In Cell No. 7.
output.anger: aku benar-benar mau nonton filmnya, tapi gegara seriesnya udah ada, jadi harus cancel dan terpaksa nonton Miracle In Cell No. 7, rasanya begitu mengesalkan!
output.surprise: aku sebenarnya mau nonton filmnya, tapi tiba-tiba seriesnya udah ada, jadi cancel dan nonton Miracle In Cell No. 7, wah aku tidak menyangka!
output.disgust: aku seharusnya mau nonton filmnya, tapi muncul seriesnya yang bikin aku cancel dan terpaksa nonton Miracle In Cell No. 7, rasanya menjengkelkan!
